topics.title: Gay Comedians Discuss Personal Life
topics.summary: During an interview, Howard Stern and his guests discuss their personal lives, including romantic interests, past relationships, and experiences with sexuality, often punctuated by humorous observations and self-deprecating remarks about dating challenges and awkward encounters. The conversation includes tangents on family dynamics and preferences for certain types of men.

topics.title: Steve Rubell Death, Insurance & Gay Comedy
topics.summary: During the broadcast, host Howard discusses the death of Steve Rubell due to hepatitis and septic shock while simultaneously interviewing a gay comedy troupe. The group describes their individual stand-up routines and explores themes of identity within their performances, including navigating societal expectations around sexuality and relationships.

topics.title: Hair Carvings and Hot Tub Troubles
topics.summary: A man discusses elaborate head carvings – Mount Rushmore, Batman insignia, a rat’s maze, and a vagina – while recounting bizarre encounters including a broken back from reaching for the designs. He details an interracial marriage with a model and shares anecdotes about meeting Charles Barkley and Donald Trump at a hot tub.

topics.title: Marriage Troubles and Baseball Obsessions
topics.summary: The broadcast centers around a man's skeptical concerns about his wife’s trustworthiness, fueled by anxieties regarding basketball’s impact on their relationship. Discussions shift to unrelated topics including a police officer shot in the head returning to work, weather forecasts, and an outlandish theory involving gambling on baseball games.

topics.title: Phone Calls and Beirut Crisis
topics.summary: During this broadcast, hosts discuss an impending threat against Marine Lieutenant Colonel William Higgins in Beirut due to a Sheikh’s actions, speculate about Lebanon's communication difficulties (no circuits), and attempt to contact Fortman’s assistant. They also briefly interview Harvey Firestein regarding John Lovett’s impression.

topics.title: Rob Lowe & The Strange Phone Call
topics.summary: During a radio discussion, callers debate Rob Lowe’s reduced community service sentence (20 hours instead of two years) and his reported interest in sharing details about sexual encounters. A bizarre phone call ensues with the individual who provided Rob Lowe's number, leading to speculation and awkward inquiries regarding his personal life.
